news.title: Western Ministil Limited (BSE:504998) completed the acquisition of Micron Calcite Private Limited for INR 4.5 million.
news.body:
Western Ministil Limited (BSE:504998) agreed to acquire Micron Calcite Private Limited for INR 4.5 million on March 12, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 4.54 million valued at INR 454 per share will be paid by Western Ministil Limited. As part of consideration, INR 4.54 million is paid towards common equity of Micron Calcite Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Micron Calcite Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 22.34 million.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by acquirer board and shareholders. The deal has been approved by the board of Western Ministil Limited. The expected completion of the transaction is in two months.

news.title: Western Ministil Limited Announces Directorate Changes
news.body: Western Ministil Limited held its Extra-Ordinary General Meeting on April 15, 2026, the shareholders approved the regularization of Mr. Kalpesh Naginbhai Patel (DIN: 02224612) as Non-Executive Director. The shareholders also approved the regularization of Mrs. Vandana Patel as Non-Executive Director. Additionally, the shareholders approved the appointment of Mrs. Hiralben Mehulsinh Gohil (DIN: 11146010) as the Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company for a term of 5 Years.
